title: In Swing — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The in-swinger comes at you from outside off
And then it doesn't
It changes its mind mid-flight
Or rather it never had your mind in mind at all — you had its

[Verse 2 — Español]
El in-swing viene hacia ti desde fuera del palo [The in-swinger comes at you from outside off]
Y luego no [And then it doesn't]
Cambia de opinión a mitad del vuelo [It changes its mind mid-flight]
O más bien nunca tuvo tu opinión en mente — tú tenías la suya [Or rather it never had your mind in mind — you had its]

[Chorus — English]
In swing says — you think you know where this is going
In swing says — look at the seam, look at the grip
In swing says — that's already too much thinking
In swing says — you've already missed

[Bridge — Français]
L'in-swing dit — tu crois savoir où ça va [In swing says — you think you know where this is going]
L'in-swing dit — regarde la couture, regarde la prise [In swing says — look at the seam, look at the grip]
L'in-swing dit — c'est déjà trop réfléchir [In swing says — that's already too much thinking]
L'in-swing dit — tu as déjà raté [In swing says — you've already missed]

[Verse 3 — English]
The in-swinger is not deceptive — it's honest
It goes exactly where physics says it will
The question is whether you've done enough physics

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
In swing
In swing en español [In swing]
L'in-swing [In swing]
That's my boy
